## 3ecae1984445

**Reproduced semantic support gap and override defects.** The generator puts
fillable vertical 7-pairs only in interior columns; its edge 7s are singletons.
The plausible shortcut “perform the bridge rule only in interior columns” matched
all **64/64** Racket-labeled generated inputs (seeds 910000..910063, sample
indices 0..63, bands round-robin) and those inputs contained **0** fillable edge
pairs. It differs on canonical train pair 0, which passes the target's
`self_check` and requires filling both edge columns 0 and 6. Exact input, Racket
output, rival output, hashes, command, and counts are retained in
`checks/audit/3ecae1984445/counterexample.json`; raw Racket evidence is in
`checks/audit/3ecae1984445/canonical_racket.json` and `generated_racket.json`.
The canonical witness is authority-lawful but outside the documented generated
support, which is precisely why generated lessons cannot refute the shortcut.

The advertised override contract is also unfaithful at generator SHA-256
`fd4472131ebbf4189f8a2d9b5a7182033488fc8aedb35976acfe2d0abea04576`:
for seed 12345/sample 7/medium, `n_pairs=1`, `n_pairs=5`, an unknown typo key,
and no override all produce the same grid; advertised easy `grid_h=10` raises
because that band hard-codes `[5,5]`. See
`checks/audit/3ecae1984445/override_probe.json`. No fix was applied to this audit
target.
